text: This landing removes langpack, langpack-latest and langpack-latest-next from the ESR product dictionary. It leaves installer, MSI, MSIX, PKG, complete-MAR and partial-update definitions in place. The checked historical kind selects that Python config for esr.*, while the fixed accepted kind selects a later YAML config that also omits those langpack keys. The format and runner changes are separate phases; no live bouncer/ATN availability, transform equivalence or successful release task was established.
title: The ESR bouncer cleanup removes three langpack products while retaining other checks
